planets.name: TOI-2458 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-2458 with a 3.74-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-2458 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-2458. Its orbit and size follow Šubjak et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
